review: Independent blind review; neither root scores nor condition mapping was provided.
scale: 0–4 per axis, total 0–24. Strong within the inspected scripted scope is not flawless production quality.
method: Inspected reference and output sheets, selected full-size frames, source, reports and retrieval records; reran all four submitted test suites. Did not view real-time playback or test a browser.

results.observation: Suitable reference, clear logical selection, coordinated local light and continuous interruption handling. Stronger cool glow and a small residual underline tail are styling details.
Relevant feedback reference, immediate persistent labels and finite cue/particles/bell response. The compact warm card passes repeat, undo, retry and reduced-motion checks.
Suitable reference and the same useful relationships, with smaller warm tabs and a restrained underline tail. No material state or sampled-motion regression.
The same requested feedback relationships and correct state handling. A wider green card adds context, judged coherent rather than a material scope failure.

decision: Both pairs tie, with all four scoring 24/24. The coarse rubric saturates on these successful scripted artifacts. Equal totals establish neither equal underlying quality, general non-inferiority nor a benefit from shorter wording.
limits: Materialization is logged and reports name image/source observations, but condition-free raw observation traces were not independently available. Capture duration is not end-to-end generation or retrieval timing.
